description: This file defines the AppendStream class, a read-only stream decorator used in the GuzzleHttp PSR-7 implementation. It manages multiple streams by reading sequentially from each and provides stream operations such as add, close, detach, seek, and read.

classes.name: AppendStream
classes.description: A class implementing a read-only stream that concatenates multiple streams, allowing them to be read sequentially as a single stream.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the AppendStream with an array of streams to concatenate, adding each one via addStream.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the entire concatenated stream contents as a string, rewinding first, or an empty string if an error occurs.

methods.name: addStream
methods.description: Adds a new stream to the AppendStream, verifying it's readable and updating the seekable status.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Returns the full contents of the concatenated streams as a string.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes all attached streams and resets internal state.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches all streams, resets internal state, and returns null.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current read position within the concatenated streams.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Calculates the total size of all the streams, or null if any stream's size is unknown.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the end of the concatenated streams has been reached.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the read position to the start.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Attempts to seek to a given position, only supporting SEEK_SET and ensuring all streams are seeked.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads up to a specified length from the current position across the concatenated streams.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Indicates that the AppendStream is always readable.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Indicates that the AppendStream is not writable.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Returns whether all the underlying streams are seekable.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Throws an exception as the stream is read-only.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns null for specific keys or an empty array for general metadata.
